benchmark_scope: Historical categorical multiple-myeloma LOT classification from ordered normalized drug sets only; never treatment recommendation.

observable_concepts.guidance: Identical consecutive normalized drug sets support SAME_LINE, but an unavailable long gap could change the interpretation.
An added active drug may indicate NEW_LINE, but the 28-day build window, progression, toxicity, and intent are unavailable; use uncertainty when those distinctions matter.
A strict subset may be de-escalation, maintenance, toxicity management, or a new phase. Without dates or intent this is context-limited and may require INSUFFICIENT_INFORMATION.
A fully non-overlapping active regimen usually supports NEW_LINE unless the observable tokens plausibly represent a planned transplant or cellular-therapy workflow.
Exact reappearance after an observable intervening different regimen supports a rechallenge and NEW_LINE; this does not establish anything about an unobserved gap.
Recognize the token, but conditioning adjacency, frontline status, and maintenance timing are unavailable. Do not assume that nearby events form one line.
A recognizable CAR-T product is a treatment event. Flu/Cy can be lymphodepletion, but timing and intent are unavailable, so do not automatically join it to CAR-T.
Repeated identical appearances of the same bispecific are continuation. Step-up timing is unavailable.
Do not invent a drug identity. Mark affected transitions INSUFFICIENT_INFORMATION.
Steroid-only intent can be active treatment, bridging, symptom control, or palliation. Mark an affected boundary uncertain when intent is necessary.

independence_rule: Interpret the order-only sequence independently. This knowledge is not a copy of the project rule algorithm and contains no algorithm flags or implementation details.
